items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: Don't be his uncle. Yeah. Yeah. He'd be a friend. He's working downtown somewhere

ctx.x: Jack. That's right. Jack. I saw him but I don't know him.
Don't be his uncle. Yeah. Yeah. He'd be a friend. He's working downtown somewhere and she could play.
He's working. Well, while I think of it, did you have any other brothers that played any music? No one else in the family then that played music? No.
